يتعجرفان (form IIq)
# يَتَعَجْرَفَانِ (yataʕajrafāni) /ja.ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra.faː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
# يُتَعَجْرَفَانِ (yutaʕajrafāni) /ju.ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra.faː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
